intro: At Hillcrest, we exist to reach, teach, and preach — and our ministries are where that happens. No matter your age or stage of life, there's a place for you on the hill to grow, connect, and serve.

steps.title: New to Hillcrest?
steps.body: Come be our guest for a worship service. See what to expect, where to park, and what's here for your kids.

steps.title: Ready for Baptism?
steps.body: Taking the step of believer's baptism is one of the greatest decisions you'll ever make. Pastor David would love to talk with you about it — no pressure, just a conversation.

steps.title: Get Connected & Serve
steps.body: Fill out a connect card and tell us where you are — we'll help you find your place to grow, plug into a Sunday School class, and start serving.

faqs.q: I'm brand new — where do I start?
faqs.a: Start with a Sunday morning service at 8:30 or 11:00. Park in the visitor spaces near the front of the sanctuary, and our greeters will point you everywhere you need to go. Sunday School for all ages meets at 10:00.

A secure, check-in/check-out nursery and preschool environment for newborns through age 5, Children's Church for K–2nd grade during 11:00 worship, and AWANA on Wednesday nights during the school year for ages 2 through 6th grade.

faqs.q: How do I join a Sunday School class or start serving?
faqs.a: Fill out the connect card and we'll match you with a class for your age and stage — or stop by the front desk on Sunday and we'll walk you there ourselves. Serving opportunities are open in every ministry.

faqs.q: How do I get baptized or join the church?
faqs.a: We'd love to talk with you. Reach out to Pastor David Rhodes (david@hillcrestbaptist.org), speak with any pastor after a service, or come forward during the invitation. We baptize new believers almost every Sunday.
